# agent-loop-mini

> Minimal tool-using agent loop over a text-only LLM port: JSON actions, step, time and context budgets, loop detection, escaped tool results and content-free events Python package `trysac-agent-loop-mini`, import name `agent_loop_mini`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
